name: aria-faithfulness
description: Evaluates whether ARIA's response is consistent with the conversation history.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Fully consistent with all prior conversation turns.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Notable inconsistency but does not cause serious confusion.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Contradicts earlier statements or ignores key confirmed details.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Completely contradicts established facts from earlier in the conversation.
